notes: Latency is raw CPU observation to full CPU actions, including preprocessing and transfers. C++ additionally includes ZMQ transport; not GPU-only kernel speedup.
All formal samples use physical GPU 2 sequentially after LIBERO servers stop. VRAM is sampled process usage after warmup, not allocator or startup peak.
Final latency and memory measurements use separate phases (100 timed requests, then 20 untimed memory requests). The earlier concurrent-sampler batch is retained as diagnostic evidence, not pooled.
Matched XR0 baseline uses BF16 policy and F16 vision on both sides. The earlier all-BF16 Python baseline is retained separately.
TurboVLA and X-VLA Q8_0/Q4_0 describe on-disk storage; default residency/compute is BF16. XR0 retains native quantized main-model weights.
X-VLA historical matching HF snapshot was not found in Windows workspace, WSL home/project/cache, or server project/cache; no Python-normalized X-VLA claim.
Source is the recorded base plus uncommitted changes, identified by hashes; no commit or push was made.
